title: dupatya pulchra
intro: Dupatya pulchra, commonly known as the "beautiful dupatya," is a plant species in the family Rutaceae that is native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation and the improvement of respiratory issues, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Dupatya pulchra include limonoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antiviral, and anti-cancer activities. The plant's therapeutic actions also include sedative, analgesic, and anti-diabetic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
